title: Square Spiral
reference: repeat 2 { tally_up repeat 2 { repeat tally { forward forward } turn_right } }
hints: The spiral grows after every two sides: 2, 2, then 4, 4.
Count once, then walk two sides with the same tally.
repeat 2 { tally_up repeat 2 { repeat tally { forward forward } turn_right } }
